# daftari

> daftari turns an exported WhatsApp chat into a clean ledger. It reads the M-PESA confirmations, bank alerts and other payment messages buried in the chat and lists every transaction, dated and categorised, ready to filter and export.

daftari is a free web app made by Eddie Ezekiel Ochieng in Kenya.

## How it works

- Upload a WhatsApp chat export.
- Payment messages are read by rules, not guesswork: M-PESA (Paybill, Buy Goods and transfers), Airtel Money, bank alerts, remittances, KRA payments and foreign currencies.
- AI is used only to suggest a category for the few transactions the rules cannot place.
- Every transaction carries a confidence score; anything uncertain goes to a Review Queue for the user to confirm.
- Export the ledger to CSV, JSON or Excel.

## Privacy

The chat is parsed in memory and discarded. Nothing is written to a database or disk.
